posts.text: If AI systems derive value from news, the organizations that invest in reporting, fact-finding, and accountability journalism must have leverage in determining the terms of that relationship. The UK CMA’s binding conduct requirement on Google is a first step toward that, writes Courtney C. Radsch.

ai-technology.quote: "AI is a normal technology, meaning it can be adopted and analyzed using normal business principles; the abnormality is in how we talk about it" mattdpearce.substack.com/p/the-logic-...

If AI systems derive value from news, the organizations that invest in reporting, fact-finding, and accountability journalism must have leverage in determining the terms of that relationship. The UK CMA’s binding conduct requirement on Google is a first step toward that, writes Courtney C. Radsch.

AI forces a “paranoid reading” style on people who don’t want to be paranoid readers and on non-using writers who just want to be taken on their own (human) terms.
